intent: Expose the shared agent tool registry over MCP at /api/mcp: unauthenticated requests get a 401 with an RFC 9728 challenge; authenticated ones run tools as the caller.
summary: Implemented the MCP surface per docs/backend-architecture/agent-layer-mcp.md: src/agent/auth.ts verifies the caller's Supabase JWT against the project JWKS with jose (no secret key), src/agent/adapters/mcp.ts registers every tool from the one shared registry and forwards the user's JWT into a per-call Supabase client so RLS decides rows, src/app/api/mcp/route.ts wraps the handler in withMcpAuth, and src/app/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/route.ts serves the RFC 9728 metadata the 401 challenge points at. TDD: the auth-gate test failed first for the right reason (route missing), then passed 3/3. Extracted the duplicated chainable Supabase mock into src/agent/testing/fake-supabase.ts and deleted the copy in agent.test.ts. Corrected the spec's 1.x-era assumptions against the installed mcp-handler 2.2.0 (ctx.http.authInfo, not extra.authInfo) and pinned the annotation on the tool callback because AgentTool's zod input is a generic ZodType that blocks overload inference. Full gate: typecheck 0 errors, lint 0/0 on 299 files, 19/19 unit tests.

decisions.decision: Install mcp-handler/@modelcontextprotocol/server/jose without pausing for human approval
decisions.reason: Not a scope expansion: the card title names 'MCP endpoint with mcp-handler 2.x' and the spec section gives the exact versions. C-15 covers unrequested deps; these were requested by the card.

decisions.decision: Follow mcp-handler 2.2.0's real API over the doc's example where they differ
decisions.reason: The spec's route example matches 2.x, but its prose implied 1.x's extra.authInfo. Verified against the installed README: v2 moved it to ctx.http?.authInfo. Doc updated expectation noted for PSI-073 reviewer.

decisions.decision: Verify the JWT with jose against Supabase JWKS instead of calling auth.getUser
decisions.reason: Keeps the gate stateless and edge-friendly, and reads only public key material — no secret key in this layer, which is C-04.

decisions.decision: Annotate the callback params (args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ServerContext) rather than loosen the schema
decisions.reason: AgentTool.input is typed as a generic z.ZodType, so registerTool's overload cannot infer the callback arity. Annotating is one line and keeps the registry's types honest.

verification.manual: 19/19 unit tests green across 4 files (3 auth-gate + 3 adapter + 13 pre-existing agent tests). TDD honoured: the auth-gate test was written first and failed with 'Cannot find module ../route' before the route existed.

human_review.reason: The AC's second clause (with a valid Supabase JWT the tools list and run as that user) is verified at the adapter boundary — JWT forwarded, RLS client built, audit row written — but not end-to-end against a live Supabase instance. Confirm the JWKS issuer ({project}/auth/v1) matches the deployed project, and decide whether a real authenticated MCP call should be proven before merge.
